### REQ-022 rollback plan (NOT executed yet — QA task-85 still needs the Hub alive) — 2026-09-28T17:38:51Z

Order is mandatory (L-R20-1): stop (reversible) -> QA evidence -> delete (IRREVERSIBLE).
The Lead executes stop/delete by default (REQ-022 §8.5); Dev keeps the instance alive until QA finishes.

# 1) R1 stop — reversible, record + data kept
$ arc service stop -i arcblog-hub
EXPECT: 'Stopped arcblog-hub' / exit 0
$ arc service status -i arcblog-hub
EXPECT: no longer 'up' (stopped / not running), exit 0
$ lsof -nP -iTCP:4941 -sTCP:LISTEN
EXPECT: EMPTY output, exit 1

# 2) R2 delete — IRREVERSIBLE (record + data)
$ arc service delete -i arcblog-hub
EXPECT: exit 0; add --force only if the process is still running ('Stop a running instance before deleting it')

# 3) R3 back to the A1 baseline: only 'default' remains, and its id/port/home/pid semantics are unchanged
$ arc service list --json
EXPECT: instances == [ default ] with id 37a8eec1ce19687d, port 4939, home /Users/shenxiuqiang, spaceRoot /Users/shenxiuqiang/.afs/spaces
        (pid 46916 was the Round-20 baseline; a live pid may differ only if the operator restarted it — we did NOT)

# 4) R4 4941 has no listener
$ lsof -nP -iTCP:4941 -sTCP:LISTEN
EXPECT: EMPTY output, exit 1 (same as the Round-20 baseline)
$ arc service url -i arcblog-hub
EXPECT: non-zero exit / unknown instance

# 5) R5 ~/.afs-hub disposition
$ ls -la /Users/shenxiuqiang/.afs-hub
EXPECT: either 'No such file or directory' (deleted with the instance) or a residual listing to be logged row by row
        (Round-20 baseline: the directory did NOT exist; created by 'arc service start' at 17:30:54 UTC)

# 6) R6 'arc service gc' is NOT a rollback tool (it only drops registry records whose process is gone)
# 7) R7 default (4939) was never stopped / restarted / deleted in this round.
